recipe.visualDefinition: A low-angle perspective of a classic theater marquee featuring large, illuminated bulb-filled lettering against a glowing white background, framed by rows of warm incandescent light bulbs and dark wood architectural details.
coreVisualRelationships: The large bulb-filled letters dominate the central glowing panel.
The perspective creates a three-dimensional corner effect with secondary panels below.
Warm yellow light from the bulbs contrasts with the dark, shadowed architectural background.
The geometric repetition of the light bulbs creates a rhythmic border around the text.
coreInvariants: High-contrast black text on a backlit white surface
Bulb-filled interior for the primary display word

compositionAndHierarchy.subjectPositionAndScale: The primary title is centered and oversized, occupying 70% of the upper marquee panel.
compositionAndHierarchy.visualAnchor: The corner of the marquee where the two lower panels meet, creating a strong vertical axis.
compositionAndHierarchy.movementAndEyePath: Eyes start at the large illuminated title, move down the corner axis to the secondary information on the lower panels.
compositionAndHierarchy.negativeSpace: The glowing white panels act as negative space that pushes the black text forward.

colorSystem.dominantColorRole: Warm White/Cream (backlit panels and bulb glow)
colorSystem.contrastColorRole: Deep Brown/Black (architectural frame and text silhouettes)
colorSystem.accentColorRole: Golden Yellow (direct light from the bulbs)
colorSystem.saturationAndValueRelationship: High value contrast between the glowing panels and the dark shadows of the theater exterior.
paletteRestrictions: Limit to warm spectrum and monochrome

letterConstructionRules: Primary word uses thick, rounded strokes filled with a grid of circular light bulbs.
Secondary text uses a clean, heavy-weight geometric sans-serif.
Tight letter spacing with slight overlaps in the primary word.
characterSpecificRedesigns: The 'g' features a large, circular bowl and a descending loop that integrates with the baseline.
The 'l' is a simple vertical bar filled with a single column of bulbs.
typographyAndGraphicLanguage.pairingStrategy: Uniformity through weight; using the same geometric skeleton for both display and subtitle text to maintain brand cohesion.

candidateDirections.reason: Matches the geometric circularity and tight kerning potential.
Provides the necessary weight and geometric purity.

twoStageComposition.backgroundInstruction: Generate a 3D low-angle shot of a theater marquee at night. The marquee should have a large glowing white upper panel and two smaller angled panels below. Frame the panels with dark wood and rows of glowing warm light bulbs. The background should show a blurred theater facade with windows.
twoStageComposition.overlayInstruction: Apply the primary title in a lowercase geometric sans-serif on the upper panel, filling the letters with a grid of small light bulbs. Apply secondary text on the lower panels in solid black, ensuring the text follows the perspective of the angled panels.

verificationChecks: Are the bulbs inside the letters aligned to the letter shapes?
Does the perspective of the lower text match the marquee angle?
Is the glow from the bulbs casting light on the surrounding frame?

postGenerationChecks: Check for consistent light source direction.
Ensure text is legible despite the bulb texture.
Verify the 'g' descender doesn't clip the frame.
Confirm the glow doesn't wash out the black text edges.
recipe.reuseFormula: Theater Marquee + Geometric Sans + Bulb-Fill Texture + Low-Angle Perspective
